d: Short, messy, dark espresso-colored hair with choppy bangs falls over the forehead. The eyes are a sharp amber shade with a confident, slight smirk on a youthful, mature face. The build is lean, dressed in a layered outfit consisting of a high-collared black undershirt, a white inner garment, and a blue and dark charcoal technical jacket featuring a white floral emblem on the shoulder. Signature details include a silver chain necklace with a white rectangular pendant and a jagged, silver metallic earring hanging from the right ear.
